part.text:
I couldn't open the profile. The author of the first post in the Following feed is **whiskers** (@whiskers.test), but I have no way to tap on the device with the tools I'm allowed to use.

What I tried:
- **Profile web link** (`https://bsky.app/profile/whiskers.test`): Safari opened and showed "Unable to resolve handle". I closed Safari and relaunched Bluesky, which returned to the Following feed.
- **App deep link** (`bluesky://profile/whiskers.test`): this worked. The app shows an **"Open in 'Bluesky'?"** confirmation dialog, which is still on screen. Tapping **Open** would load whiskers' profile.

The only tap-capable binary I found is a `cliclick` shim in `~/.cache/bench-shims-none/`. I didn't use it, because host-level mouse input is out of scope for this environment.

To finish, tap **Open** on the dialog, or tap the "whiskers" name on the first post. I can keep trying other approaches if you can enable a tap mechanism for the simulator, such as an XCUITest runner.
